text: ἡ Ἐμπορὶς ἔρχεται καὶ δίδωσι ἄρτον τῷ Πάνδᾳ καὶ τῷ Διναυσάρῳ.
objects: two small round loaves of bread with golden crusts
positioning: Emporis approaches from the left carrying bread in her hands
Panda reaches out to accept one loaf with both hands
Dinosaur extends his arms to receive the other loaf
Two small round loaves of bread with golden crusts are being offered to the children
